topic: Among children in the pneumococcal conjugate vaccine context, is asthma associated with invasive pneumococcal disease (IPD)?

pico.population: Children or identifiable pediatric subgroups in primary asthma-IPD reports in the PCV context; record individual PCV and PPSV23 histories when reported, without assuming or requiring them.
pico.comparison: Children without asthma or without known IPD risk factors when reported. Retain a primary pediatric asthma-IPD report without a comparative ratio as source-only evidence; decide quantitative usability after extraction.
pico.outcome: Invasive pneumococcal disease (IPD) as defined by the primary report; preserve whether ascertainment used sterile-site microbiology, surveillance, or administrative records.

eligible_study_designs: Primary cohort, case-control, or population surveillance/descriptive study reporting pediatric asthma and IPD; mixed-age reports qualify when pediatric results are identifiable.

targets.outcome: Invasive pneumococcal disease (IPD) as defined by the primary report; preserve whether ascertainment used sterile-site microbiology, surveillance, or administrative records.
targets.comparison: Children with asthma versus children without asthma or without known risk factors
targets.population_or_subgroup: Children; preserve source age stratum and calendar year

timepoint_policy.rule: Preserve source-reported age stratum and calendar year; do not pool overlapping cohorts twice.

targets.effect_selection_rule: Retain each source-reported comparative OR, RR, or incidence rate ratio for the target outcome and its explicitly defined age stratum or year. Preserve whether adjustment was reported; do not infer adjustment from age stratification. Mark overlapping-cohort effects as quantitative but not independently poolable.
extraction_notes: Do not create arm counts from reported rates or ratios.
A record lacking an asthma-versus-control ratio is retained only as source-only evidence.
Preserve source-reported PCV/PPSV23 status and IPD ascertainment; missing individual vaccine status or sterile-site confirmation does not by itself invalidate an asthma-IPD report.
Preserve each source-reported OR, RR, or incidence rate ratio as its own effect measure; do not relabel a rate ratio as an odds ratio or risk ratio.
source_constraints: do not count overlapping cohorts twice
